title: Gunda Gardi
desc: A righteous police commissioner, Karan Singh, tries to nab the notorious mafia duo, Narasimha and Kalicharan. After his brother-in-law gets murdered, he plans to take help from the eye-witness, Deepa, to get hold of the criminals.

title: Dastaan
desc: Vishnu, a reputed judge, is assumed to be Anil, an absconding murderer. However, he decides to travel to Anil's home town and unravel the mystery behind his lookalike's existence.

title: Zulm O Sitam
desc: Superintendent of Police, Arun, has been assigned to lead the detail in charge of the state's Chief Minister's protection. However, things do not go as planned and the Chief Minister is killed.
